title: Asking a coverage question is one command
statement: change-saga check --against main --covers implementation,stories app.saga answers whether the named areas are fully covered; nothing is required unless someone asks.

acceptance_criteria.statement: check exits zero when every named area is fully covered, and non-zero with only those areas' gaps when not.
With --against the scope is the change, what it changed and what it affected; without it, the whole app; --epic narrows either.
